{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Now, follow the contract exactly:
# Population: all orders from new customers reached by paid search
# This includes refunded orders
filtered_population = sales[
    (sales['customer_segment'] == 'new') &
    (sales['channel'] == 'paid_search')
]

# Number of such orders (denominator)
denominator = len(filtered_population)

# Converted: 1 if the order completed checkout
# This is already defined in the 'converted' column
# But note: the 'converted' column is 1 only if checkout was completed
# Refunded orders are not converted, even if they were paid
numerator = filtered_population['converted'].sum()

# Fraction converted
fraction_converted = numerator / denominator

# Print the required numbers
print(f"Number of new customers reached by paid search (all status): {denominator}")
print(f"Number of converted orders among them: {numerator}")
print(f"Fraction converted: {fraction_converted}")"}
